messages:
mariam: Quick note: after updating the sampleapp deps the rerank job crashes when building the embedding matrix — one vector shows length 1535 vs expected 1536. Anyone else hit weird per-item length mismatches?

mariam: We're using BatchingHelper from the devex sample repo (python) and calling client.embed. Minimal request sent to the API: 
```json
{"model":"redwood/embed-small","input":["s1","s2"]}
```

mariam: SDK-run prints: len(vec0)=1536
len(vec1)=1535

alex: first isolation step: can you curl the hosted endpoint and compare with jq to confirm server-side dims? Also, any sidecar proxies, gzip wrappers, or auth rotations in your runtime?

mariam: Good call. curl against https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings | jq '.data[].embedding | length' returns:

1536
1536

mariam: So server returns correct numbers. Likely SDK batching/reshape/local streaming issue rather than server.

kevin: FYI 1.5.x changed how the helper packs vectors when pad_multiple is None/omitted. There's Flatten->Concat->Reshape logic that might miscompute the final stride when there is no padding. Could be an off-by-one trim during reshape.

rui: Also consider auth rotation / retry semantics: if token refresh triggers a retry and the streaming iterator is reused, partial bytes could be interleaved. Does disabling retries change behavior?

mariam: Tried both: disabling retry_on_auth (retry_on_401=False) didn't change the outcome. But setting pad_multiple=64 made both lengths 1536 consistently.

mariam: Current call site (snippet):
```python
from redwood import Client, BatchingHelper
client = Client()
helper = BatchingHelper(client.embed, batch_size=4, pad_multiple=None, retry_on_401=True)
for out in helper.map(["s1","s2"]):
    print(len(out["embedding"]))
```

alex: Thanks, that's a clean reproducer. If pad_multiple=64 masks it then reshape/pack is a suspect. Can you also try the raw client call without the helper to confirm helper is the cause?

mariam: Raw client call (no helper) returns 1536/1536, so helper is implicated.

kevin: I'll take this. Plan: add unit that calls helper.map and compare each returned length to curl/jq length. Also add fuzzing where we emulate chunked streaming and gzipped response boundaries to see if deserializer loses a float at boundary.

rui: I'll add an integration CI job that runs the sdk against hosted endpoint and fails if any embedding length != length from curl/jq for the same call. Helps catch regressions.

ops-bot: CI triggered: py-sdk/pr-embed-helper-fix (job 612) queued.

mariam: Temporary mitigation: set pad_multiple=64 in sampleapp and add a blurb in onboarding docs: "If SDK embeddings differ from curl, try pad_multiple=64 or disable the helper to isolate."

kevin: Will check BatchingHelper.reshape() and ensure we compute per-item lengths from server metadata if available; otherwise use per-item lengths stored during unpack instead of relying on total // n. Also add regression test for pad_multiple=None path.

rui: Opening a customer-impact tracking ticket just in case (TKT-987).

mariam: Will attach failing stacktrace + minimal repro repo to the issue once uploaded. Thanks all for quick triage :pray:
